summary_en: KOYOSHA revised its FY2027 dividend forecast upward to 17 yen per share (from 11 yen) following the completion of a golf membership transfer expected to generate 86 million yen in special profit. The increase reflects the company's dividend policy targeting a 30% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Recording of Special Profit, Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast (Upward Revision), and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
KOYOSHA announced the completion of a golf membership transfer that will generate special profit of 86 million yen in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The transfer was executed to optimize held assets and improve capital efficiency. As a result, the company revised its net income attributable to parent company shareholders upward from 90 million yen to 145 million yen.

In conjunction with this special profit, KOYOSHA revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share was increased from 11 yen to 17 yen, with both the interim (second quarter-end) and year-end dividends set at 17 yen per share. This revision reflects the company's dividend policy of targeting a 30% payout ratio while maintaining stable dividends based on business earnings and preserving internal reserves for future business development.

The revision had no impact on sales, operating profit, or ordinary profit. The company notes that its basic dividend policy remains focused on stable distributions derived from business earnings for each period, supported by adequate retained earnings.
